method:
Out-of-sample test of pattern classes (read-only research). Output: data/oos.json
Method: segments = same rolling segments as the atlas library (stride w//2, all windows), classified by rule (no look-ahead: class uses only the segment itself).
Split by segment END time: train < SPLIT, test >= SPLIT (1D/4H/1H: 2020-01-01; 15M: 2022-01-01).
Per cell (instrument x timeframe x type, windows pooled) and horizon h in {5,20}: thin to non-overlapping forward windows (end idx spaced >= h bars),
compare up-rate (r_h>0.05%) against unconditional baseline of ALL bars in the same period (removes drift); exact binomial two-sided p; mean excess vs same-period baseline mean via t-test.
Multiple testing: Benjamini-Hochberg across all test cells with n>=30. Selection test: cells significant in train (p<.05,n>=30) -> same direction in test?
